title: Need To Chill?
description: Remember the times you ate Ice Cubes out from the Freezer? NOW YOU CAN!
body:
Have you ever ate Ice Cubes right out off the Freezer? NOW YOU CAN! Intruducing: Need To Chill?

A terribly coded and designed Mod that is suprisingly good?..
 In this Mod you can create Saw Blades and Cutting Stations to craft Fridges to Freezers so you can create a better and **COOLER** Food Source that is for some reason harder to get. You can get Ice Cubes, Packed Ice Cubes (like the one from Gravity Falls tbh) and Blue Ice Cubes.

 You can also trade a Cleric for an expensive, broken (litterally not OP/ doesnt work and its not a bug) and useless Inverted Totem. Maybe you can fix it?..

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/8miiP2GjpsM" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
       Hope y'all a **_Chilly_** Day! Cya!

Items;


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

       **Saw:** An item you can craft for less than 2 Iron Ingots to break blocks faster and hit better.
       
       **Cutting Station:** A block that does absolutely nothing other than Crafting into a better item.
       
       **Industrial Cutting Station**: A block that does absolutely nothing other than Crafting into a better item.
       
       **Fridge**: A block that does absolutely nothing other than Crafting into a better item.
       
       **Freezer**: A block that does absolutely nothing other than Crafting into a better item.
      
       **Ice Cube:** An item that fills 1 Hunger Bar and gives 0.1 Saturation.
      
       **Packed Ice Cubes:** An item that fills 4 Hunger Bar and gives 0.4 Saturation.
       
       **Blue Ice Cube:** An item that fills 6 Hunger Bar and gives 0.6 Saturation.
      
       **Inverted Totem:** An item that does nothing but can be bought from a Master Level Cleric for a Stack of emerald and a Totem of Undying.
       
       **Goggles:** An Item that does absolutely nothing other than Crafting into a better item.
      
       **Purified Totem of Undying:** A Totem of Undying that activates when it is in your inventory (you dont need to hold it) and gives better effects and doesnt creates effects.
       
       **Industrial Smelter:** A block that does absolutely nothing other than Crafting into a better item.
       
       **Liquidizer:** A block that does absolutely nothing other than Crafting into a better item.
       
       **Hot Upgrade Template:** An item that does absolutely nothing other than Crafting into a better item.
       
       **Liquid Blue Ice:** When right clicked with an item even if it is not in your hand, injects Chilled Down Status Effect to you.
      
       **Ice Breaker-Version:** Minecraft: A Sword that deals 15 Damage, has 100 Durability, 22 Enchantability, 0.7 Attack Speed, also can right click to gain Speed V for 3 Seconds. DISCLAIMER: THIS ITEM HAS A SECRET WAY TO OBTAIN IN SURVIVAL THAT I WILL NOT LEAK SINCE ITS RARE. SO KEEP IN MIND THAT THIS ITEM IS KINDA SUPPOSED TO BE FOR CREATIVE ONLY.

Status Effects: **Chilled Down:** Slows the player in every way possible and gives Knockback resistance, Block Reach and Entity Reach (even tho hitting is slowed too).

</details>



You can reach for bugs from the Discord server.
FINALLY DESCRIPTION IS OVER!!! FREEDOM AT LAST!!! (Version 1.0.1 Logs)
